people.name: Festus
people.line: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case; sent him to Rome.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem, and be judged by me there concerning these things?”
translations.bsb: But Festus, wishing to do the Jews a favor, said to Paul, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem to stand trial before me on these charges?”
translations.kjv: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
translations.asv: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
